spell-density.mechanism: count cards whose type_line matches Instant or Sorcery
spell-density.rationale: spellslinger/magecraft archetypes; the magecraft otag covers only ~31 cards lake-wide so otag-based detection is dead — density over the printed card type is the general mechanism.

artifact-density.mechanism: count cards whose type_line matches Artifact

enchantment-density.mechanism: count cards whose type_line matches Enchantment

creature-type-density.mechanism: max count of any single creature subtype across the deck's creatures (from type_line after the dash)
creature-type-density.rationale: generic typal detector: a dominant shared creature subtype, independent of any specific tribe.
